title: rdf-InContext: Client-side RDF Visualiser for Enhanced Publications
description:
rdf-InContext is a lightweight, client-side JavaScript visualisation widget for Enhanced Publications — compound scholarly objects that link publications to research datasets, images, and other resources via OAI-ORE/RDF.

Originally developed in 2011–2013 by SURFfoundation as part of the SURFshare programme, rdf-InContext was deployed in production in the NARCIS Dutch national research portal and the University of Twente ESCAPE project. It renders an interactive cloud-style view of an OAI-ORE aggregation graph, letting readers navigate between related resources by clicking. No server is required for the visualisation: only the RDF data endpoint is fetched remotely.

The visualiser is embedded in a host page with a single JavaScript include and a JSON configuration block. Data can be served as RDF/XML or RDF/JSON; a schema file defines property labels, type icons, and OWL inverse/symmetric relations. Default base class types cover OAI-ORE Aggregation, FOAF (Person, Document, Image, Organisation, Project), SKOS Concept, and OWL Thing.

This repository revives and modernises the original source for GitHub Pages hosting and long-term archival under the surf-ori organisation.
